UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated learner profile and cumulative study telemetry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown on dashboard and profile.

email.description: Optional email address from Google Sign-In (owner-only PII).

contactEmail.description: Optional secondary/contact email added by the student.

phoneNumber.description: Optional mobile phone number added by the student.

scheduleDays.description: Target number of days to complete syllabus study schedule (1 to 365).

targetExam.description: Selected medical exam track (e.g., MDCAT, NUMS, ETEA).

dailyGoal.description: Target number of MCQs to practice per day (5 to 200).

totalAnswered.description: Lifetime count of MCQ attempts submitted.

totalCorrect.description: Lifetime count of correctly answered MCQs.

lastSyncedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last explicit offline sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted role record granting administrative permissions to manage the shared MCQ bank.

McqQuestion.title: McqQuestion
McqQuestion.description: Medical multiple-choice question with four options, answer key, reason/explanation, optional YouTube video link, and publish workflow status.

explanation.description: Reason explaining why the correct answer is right.

youtubeUrl.description: Optional suggested YouTube video URL discussing this MCQ topic.

linkedPostId.description: Optional StudyPost ID linking this MCQ directly to an interactive HTML topic explanation.

StudyPost.title: StudyPost
StudyPost.description: Admin-published study post containing notes, interactive HTML topic explanation, external webpage link, and suggested YouTube lecture video.

htmlContent.description: Optional Admin-uploaded interactive HTML document explaining this topic.

htmlFileName.description: Optional original filename of the uploaded interactive HTML lesson.

courseId.description: Optional CourseItem document ID linking this post/lesson to a specific course.

CourseItem.title: CourseItem
CourseItem.description: Structured medical exam course authored by Admin containing syllabus outline, level, duration, external resources, and linked posts/MCQs.

AccessKey.title: AccessKey
AccessKey.description: Special student login access key enforcing 1-user 1-device hardware binding.

SubscriptionRequest.title: SubscriptionRequest
SubscriptionRequest.description: Student JazzCash payment submission awaiting Admin verification to grant Basic or Advance plan access.

QuestionAttempt.title: QuestionAttempt
QuestionAttempt.description: Per-user state for a specific MCQ including latest selected option, correctness, bookmark status, and attempt count.

ExamSession.title: ExamSession
ExamSession.description: Completed practice or timed exam session summary for progress tracking.

StudyNote.title: StudyNote
StudyNote.description: Owner-scoped student study note or MCQ highlight.

DifficultQuestionItem.title: DifficultQuestionItem
DifficultQuestionItem.description: Owner-scoped difficult exam question flagged or authored by the student.

/users/{userId}.description: Private learner profile, exam preferences, and aggregate study metrics.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Shared 5-subject MCQ repository with clinical/conceptual reason and optional YouTube lecture URL.

/posts/{postId}.description: Admin-uploaded study posts with webpage links, interactive HTML lessons, and suggested YouTube videos.

/courses/{courseId}.description: Admin-managed structured courses with syllabus modules, linked study posts, and subject MCQ practice.

/access_keys/{keyCode}.description: Admin-issued student access keys locked to 1 user and 1 device.

/subscription_requests/{requestId}.description: Student JazzCash plan payment verification requests managed by Admin.

/users/{userId}/attempts/{attemptId}.description: Owner-scoped per-question answer history, mistake tracking, and bookmarks.

/users/{userId}/exam_sessions/{sessionId.description: Owner-scoped completed practice and timed exam history.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Owner-scoped student highlights and study notes.

/users/{userId}/difficult_questions/{ite.description: Owner-scoped difficult exam questions for targeted practice.
